private partial def getParamSubstArray (ps : Array Name) (us : Array Level) (p' : Name) (i : Nat) : Option Level :=
  if h : i < ps.size then
    let p := ps[i]
    if h : i < us.size then
      let u := us[i]
      if p == p' then some u else getParamSubstArray ps us p' (i+1)
    else none
  else none
